questions.stem: I ______ my homework already. I ______ it an hour ago.
questions.explanation: 第一空后面有already（已经），这是现在完成时的标志词，表示过去动作对现在的影响，用have finished；第二空后面有an hour ago（一小时前），这是一般过去时的标志，表示过去某个具体时间发生的动作，用finished。口诀：already现完，ago过完。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The boy ______ is reading under the tree is my brother.
questions.explanation: 先行词是The boy（指人），定语从句中缺少主语，因此用关系代词who。which用于指物；whom用于指人但在从句中作宾语；whose表示所属关系'谁的'。解题技巧：指人作主语用who，指物作主语用which/that。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: These books ______ to the library tomorrow.
questions.explanation: tomorrow表明用一般将来时；books与return之间是被动关系（书被归还），因此用一般将来时的被动语态will be returned。A是主动语态；C是一般现在时被动；D是一般过去时主动。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem:
—______ you ever ______ to the new museum?
—Yes, I ______ there last Sunday. It was amazing.
questions.explanation: 第一空ever（曾经）是现在完成时标志，且答句表明去过已回，用have been to；第二空last Sunday（上周日）是一般过去时标志，用went。干扰项C have gone to表示去了未回，与答句矛盾；A第一空时态错误；D第二空时态错误。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: Please ______ the lights when you leave the room to save energy.
questions.explanation: turn off表示'关闭'，符合'离开房间省电'的语境。turn on打开；turn up调大（音量）；turn down调小（音量）/拒绝。根据save energy（节能）可知要离开时关灯。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: The news about the environmental protection is very ______. It makes us think deeply.
questions.explanation: -ful是形容词后缀，表示'充满...的'，helpful意为'有益的、有帮助的'，符合句意'这条新闻很有意义'。help是动词/名词；helpless表示'无助的'，与句意相反；helping是动名词。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: With the ______ of technology, our life has become more convenient.
questions.explanation: 定冠词the后面需要接名词，development是develop的名词形式，意为'发展'。develop是动词；developing是现在分词/形容词（发展中的）；developed是过去分词/形容词（发达的）。固定搭配with the development of（随着...的发展）。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.group_passage:
Last month, our school held a Science Fair. All the students were asked to (8)___ creative projects that could help solve environmental problems in our daily life.

My classmate Tom and I decided to work together. We noticed that too much plastic waste (塑料垃圾) was produced in the school cafeteria (食堂) every day. We wanted to find a way to (9)___ it. After doing some research online, we learned (10)___ some plants could be used to make eco-friendly (环保的) lunch boxes.

We spent two weeks making our project. First, we collected leaves and stems from the school garden. Then we dried them and mixed them with natural glue. The most (11)___ part was shaping the mixture into boxes. We failed many times, but we never gave up. Finally, we made three perfect lunch boxes.

On the day of the Science Fair, many students and teachers came to see our project. They were surprised that our lunch boxes were not only cheap to make but also completely biodegradable (可生物降解的). The judges were impressed by our work. In the end, we (12)___ the first prize.
questions.explanation: come up with意为'想出、提出（主意、计划等）'，符合语境'想出创意项目'。look forward to期待；run away from逃离；get on with与...相处/继续做。根据宾语creative projects可知选A。

questions.stem: What happens when food waste goes to landfills according to the passage?
questions.group_passage:
Food waste is a big problem around the world. According to a report, about one-third of all food produced globally is wasted every year. This not only wastes money but also harms the environment. When food waste goes to landfills (垃圾填埋场), it produces greenhouse gases (温室气体) which cause climate change.

To solve this problem, a group of middle school students in Shenzhen started an interesting project called "Clean Your Plate" (光盘行动). They encouraged their classmates to take only the food they could finish during lunch time. They also designed creative posters and put them up in the dining hall to remind everyone not to waste food.

"At first, some students didn't take it seriously," said Li Wei, the leader of the group. "But when we showed them photos of hungry children in poor areas and explained how food waste affects the environment, they began to change their behavior. Now, most students finish their meals completely."

The project has been running for six months. The results are surprising. The amount of food waste in the school cafeteria has dropped by 40%. The school also saved money, which was later used to buy books for the library.

The success of this project shows that small actions can make a big difference. As one teacher said, "You don't need to do something huge to help the environment. Starting with your daily meals is a great choice."
questions.explanation: 细节理解题。根据第一段最后一句'When food waste goes to landfills, it produces greenhouse gases which cause climate change.'可知，食物垃圾进入垃圾填埋场会产生温室气体。A选项与原文wastes money相反；C、D未提及。
questions.label: 阅读-细节理解

options: A. Besides, limit your screen time.
B. However, don't give up your hobbies.
C. First, learn to prioritize your tasks.
D. Then, focus on one thing at a time.
E. On the other hand, study is more important.
questions.group_passage:
Many students have trouble balancing their schoolwork and hobbies. They often feel stressed because they don't have enough time for both. Here are some useful tips to help you manage your time better.

(17)___ First, you need to know which tasks are the most important. Make a list of all the things you need to do and put them in order of importance. This way, you won't waste time on less important things.

(18)___ Don't try to do everything at once. It's better to focus on one subject for 45 minutes, then take a short break. After that, you can move on to another task. This method helps your brain stay fresh and active.

(19)___ Many students spend hours on their phones or playing computer games without realizing how much time has passed. Try to set a time limit for these activities. When the time is up, stop immediately and go back to your work.

(20)___ Remember that hobbies are not a waste of time. They help you relax and develop new skills. You can schedule specific times for your hobbies, just like you schedule time for homework.

If you follow these suggestions, you will find that you have enough time for both study and fun.
questions.explanation: 考查段落主旨句。本段主要讲'要知道哪些任务最重要，按重要性排序'，即学会区分优先级。C选项'First, learn to prioritize your tasks（首先，学会优先处理任务）'概括了本段内容。注意First与后文的First呼应。
